Every `ssoosshd.yaml` key, one page per top-level section. The pages are generated from the Go structs in `server/config` -- the same source that produces the `ssoosshd.yaml(5)` man page and the annotated defaults file shipped to `/etc/ssoossh/ssoosshd.yaml`.

- [Top-level keys](./top-level/)
- [logging](./logging/) -- the main application log
- [db](./db/) -- the database connection, pooling, retries, and query logging
- [http](./http/) -- the listener, TLS, sessions, and rate limiting
- [queue](./queue/) -- the log destination for the internal message queue
- [authentication](./authentication/) -- OAuth/OIDC authentication for the server
- [ldap](./ldap/) -- optionally enriches the OIDC identity with directory attributes
- [admin](./admin/) -- administrative and auditor access
- [hsm](./hsm/) -- optionally sources the CA key from a PKCS#11 token instead of ssh_key
- [pubsub](./pubsub/) -- the message broker behind the certificate pipeline
- [cert_options](./cert_options/) -- the issuance policy for each certificate type
- [mail](./mail/) -- the relay, the sender, and the local template overrides
- [branding](./branding/) -- customizes the login page and web UI
